adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in the removeMember action (lines 53-58), the bootbox.confirm callback calls `self.get("model").removeMember(member)` but does not handle the returned promise. Looking at the model's removeMember method in group.js, it returns a Discourse.ajax promise. If this promise rejects (network/server error), there's no .catch() or error handling in the controller action, so the user would see no feedback about the failure. The member would remain in the UI as if nothing happened, with no error indication. This is a real defect in error handling.
